title: How bands and orchestras were named
summary: Robichaud's and Sidney Desvigne's groups were named after their leaders; the Maple Leaf was called an orchestra, owned by a man named Gasper.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well, John Robichaud had his band name after him. But the Maple Leaf band, it was owned by old Kyle Gasper. But they used to call it the Maple Leaf Orchestra. That was an orchestra.
Sidney Desvins band was named behind Sidney Desvins. Was that an orchestra? It was an orchestra, yeah.
